keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Atletico Madrid 1, Barcelona 0. Giuliano Simeone (Atletico Madrid) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Julián Alvarez.
Delay in match (Barcelona).
Delay in match (Atletico Madrid).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Álex Baena (Atletico Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Atletico Madrid 1, Barcelona 1. Fermín López (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
First Half ends, Atletico Madrid 1, Barcelona 1.
Substitution, Barcelona. Frenkie de Jong replaces Brian Fariñas.
Substitution, Barcelona. Andreas Christensen replaces João Cancelo.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Alexander Sørloth replaces Lee Kang-In.
Goal! Atletico Madrid 1, Barcelona 2. Fermín López (Barcelona) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Lamine Yamal with a through ball.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Morten Hjulmand replaces Koke.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Johnny Cardoso replaces Álex Baena.
Marc Bernal (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Barcelona. Eric García replaces Marc Bernal.
Substitution, Barcelona. Gavi replaces Fermín López.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Jonathan David replaces Pablo Barrios.
Substitution, Barcelona. Karim Adeyemi replaces Anthony Gordon.
Marcos Llorente (Atletico Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Marc Pubill (Atletico Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Morten Hjulmand (Atletico Madrid) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Atletico Madrid 1, Barcelona 2.
